title: AgentRuntime · AGENT manifest
description: Declarative manifest for an AgentRuntime Agent. anp-agent/v1.1 and anp-agent/v1.2 manifests are accepted.

schema_version.description: Schema version. anp-agent/v1.2 separates Agent-authored capability requests from Runtime/operator effective configuration.

kind.description: Resource kind. Only 'Agent' is valid in AgentRuntime v1.0.

instructions.description: System prompt for the Agent. Multi-line YAML string is encouraged for readability. Mutually exclusive with instructions_template.

instructions_template.description: Template with {{platform.*}} / {{caller.*}} placeholders. Mutually exclusive with instructions.

instructions_format.description: Template engine. Only plain is supported in AgentRuntime v1.x.

required_caller_keys.description: When using instructions_template, keys that must appear in StartTaskRequest.dynamic_context.

tools.description: Tools exposed to the Agent. In accepted on-disk manifests this contains API, A2A, or Runtime tool declarations only. Declare MCP servers under mcp_servers and Skills under skills[].

mcp_servers.description: v1.1 MCP server dependencies. Runtime discovers and freezes tool schemas at Task start without rewriting original MCP tool names.

skills.description: v1.1 Skill resource or registry declarations. Runtime mounts resources and validates dependencies, and may activate declared Skills into context according to activation metadata.

subagents.description: Sub-agents invocable via DeepAgents `task` tool. State is always forked (LangGraph subgraph), workspace is shared by default.

resources.description: Static resource directories bundled with the Agent and mounted into the Agent virtual filesystem. Paths are relative to AGENT.yaml.

id.description: Unique Agent identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, dot. 2-64 chars.

version.description: Semver. Used for manifest snapshot and durable Task resume stability.

trust_level.description: Agent-declared trust level upper bound. Runtime may lower it per Session or caller request, but cannot raise above this.

owner.description: Opaque owner identifier. Runtime does not interpret — pure passthrough for business systems.

exposes_a2a.description: Whether this Agent can be invoked via POST /a2a/invoke from external callers.

exposes_chat.description: Whether this Agent is exposed as a top-level chat Agent in GET /agents and can be selected by a frontend or caller via agent_id.

capabilities.description: Discovery/UI capability tags. These are not security permissions.

protocol_version.description: Optional display/discovery protocol version. schema_version remains the authoritative validator switch.

provider.description: Optional LangChain chat model provider or built-in runtime adapter. If omitted, runtime fills it from AGENT_RUNTIME_DEFAULT_MODEL_PROVIDER. Any provider supported by langchain.chat_models.init_chat_model() can pass through. Built-in/common values: dashscope, openai_compatible, openai, anthropic, bedrock, azure_openai, ollama, vllm, qwen, zhipu.

max_retries.description: Automatic retries within the same provider/model before the Runtime classifies the model error.

fallback_chain.description: Explicit model fallbacks. Runtime does not perform implicit model switching.

extra.description: Additional provider-specific kwargs forwarded to init_chat_model().

when.description: Error classes that permit this explicit fallback.

parameters.description: Provider-specific fallback parameters. Values must not contain resolved secrets.

name.description: Tool name exposed to the LLM. Must be a valid Python identifier.

spec_url.description: Path or URL to OpenAPI spec (YAML/JSON).

resolved.description: Offline-frozen resolved registry definition. Written by Runtime export/freeze; never contains resolved secret values.

checksum.description: Checksum of the offline-frozen resolved registry definition.

name.description: A2A external tool name exposed to the Agent.

async_result.description: A2A asynchronous results resume the pending tool call as an external_result.

capability.description: Runtime-provided capability to bind, such as workspace.file_read or memory.search.

config.description: Optional Runtime-tool configuration. Runtime policy may ignore or tighten it.

server_url.description: MCP server URL. Supports stdio:// (local process) and http(s):// (remote).

namespace.description: Optional prefix added to all tool names exported from this MCP server.

allowed_tools.description: Whitelist of MCP tool names exposed to the LLM. If omitted, all MCP tools are exposed.

path.description: Relative path to a DeepAgents Skill directory (containing SKILL.md).

required_mcp_tools.description: MCP tools required by this Skill, using '<mcp_name>.<tool_name>' format. AgentLoader verifies the MCP server exists and the tool is exposed by allowed_tools.

preset.description: Runtime-provided MCP preset. The runtime expands this to a trusted transport configuration.

enabled.description: Whether this MCP server declaration is enabled. Defaults to true.

isolation.description: Isolation level for preset MCP instances. Playwright currently supports task isolation only.

allowed_hosts.description: Host allowlist for Playwright preset MCP browser access.

max_concurrent_instances.description: Requested max concurrent Playwright preset instances, clamped by runtime policy.

concurrency_overflow.description: Behavior when the Playwright preset concurrency limit is reached.

concurrency_timeout_seconds.description: Queue wait timeout for Playwright preset concurrency acquisition.

artifact_retention.description: Retention policy for Playwright preset browser artifacts.

transport.description: Supported MCP transports. New Agents should prefer streamable_http.

url.description: MCP endpoint URL, command URI/profile, or ${env:...} reference.

command.description: Optional stdio command or trusted profile reference. Deployment policy must allow it.

env.description: Environment for stdio MCP servers. Sensitive values should use ${secret:...}.

allowed_tools.description: Optional allowlist of original MCP tool names.

namespace.description: Optional prefix added to all tool names exported from this MCP server.

resources.description: MCP resource exposure strategy. Runtime never dumps remote resources directly into model context.

resolved.description: Offline-frozen resolved registry definition. Written by Runtime export/freeze; never contains resolved secret values.

checksum.description: Checksum of the offline-frozen resolved registry definition.

path.description: Relative path to a Skill directory in the Agent package.

resolved.description: Offline-frozen resolved Skill definition or local path metadata. Written by Runtime export/freeze; never contains resolved secret values.

checksum.description: Checksum of the offline-frozen Skill dependency.

env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the credential. Runtime reads at startup.

token.description: Bearer/API token reference. Must be ${secret:...} or ${env:...}, never a resolved token.

RegistryRef.description: Version- or digest-pinned registry ref in type:id:version format.

id.description: Stable resource identifier within this Agent.

type.description: Resource kind. AgentRuntime mounts static package resources as virtual files or directories.

path.description: Resource path relative to AGENT.yaml. Runtime rejects paths that escape the Agent directory.

mount.description: Absolute virtual path exposed to the Agent, such as /knowledge. Runtime-owned mounts such as /workspace cannot be declared as static resources.

readonly.description: Whether the mounted resource is read-only. Static Agent resources should normally stay read-only.

include_in_export.description: Whether this resource is included when creating an agent-export.zip.

checksum.description: Optional content checksum. Loader computes it when omitted before freezing Task snapshots.

manifest.description: Path to a separate AGENT.yaml for this sub-agent. Mutually exclusive with ref and inline fields.

path.description: v1.1 path to a self-resolvable subagent AGENT.yaml.

registry.description: Registry resolver name for a version-pinned subagent ref.

ref.description: Reference to a self-resolvable subagent. v1.1 refs use agent:id:version and must be paired with registry.

metadata.description: Static subagent routing and discovery metadata such as capabilityTags and entrypoint. Not an authorization mechanism.

skills.description: Inline subagent Skill declarations. Prefer a separate self-resolvable subagent manifest for non-trivial subagents.

trust_level.description: SubAgent trust upper bound. Effective trust = min(parent_trust, this_value).

workspace_mode.description: shared (default): sub-agent uses parent Workspace (same Daytona sandbox or workspace_root). isolated: fresh sandbox. State is always forked regardless (DeepAgents subgraph native semantics).

response_format.description: DeepAgents structured output schema or schema_ref resolved by Runtime before graph build.

interrupt_on.description: DeepAgents HITL interrupt policy for this subagent.

middleware.description: DeepAgents middleware objects supplied by trusted runtime resolution.

graph_ref.description: Reference to a runtime-registered compiled graph or runnable.

required_permissions.description: Permissions the sub-agent requires to function. Enforced at call time: effective = parent ∩ declared.

resolved.description: Offline-frozen resolved subagent manifest or registry definition. Written by Runtime export/freeze.

checksum.description: Checksum of the offline-frozen subagent dependency.

allOf.comment: Either legacy 'manifest', v1.1 'path', registry ref, OR at least (name + instructions) inline

isolation_policy.description: Cross-Task state sharing policy within the same Session. Does not affect SubAgent state fork, which is always forked.

runtime_profile.description: Built-in AgentRuntime context profile. It expands to runtime dynamic sections; execution remains delegated to the runtime core.

priority.description: Context injection priority hints. Runtime owns ordering, truncation, and conflict handling.

overrides.description: Agent-owned prompt section overrides. Runtime-owned sections cannot be overridden by policy.

expose_file_tools.description: Whether the Agent requests file tools. Runtime policy may still tighten this.

approval_required_tools.description: Tool names that require approval before execution.

mode.description: untrusted defaults to block_all, verified to allowlist, platform to full.

allowed_domains.description: Required if mode=allowlist. Wildcard *. prefix allowed for subdomain wildcards.

max_subagent_depth.description: Maximum nested subagent depth enforced by ExecutionLimitMiddleware.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout for a single Task. durable Tasks waiting on input do NOT count toward this timeout.

workspace_isolation.description: When task_isolated, each Task gets a dedicated workspace namespace (task-{task_id}) unless an explicit workspace_id overrides it (spec 2026-04-29 §8).

CapabilitiesConfig.description: Agent-authored capability requests. These are requests, not grants; Runtime/operator policy resolves effective permissions at Task start.

preferred_backend.description: Preferred execution backend. Runtime policy must still allow it. Use subprocess for host-only local tools such as macOS stdio MCP agents.

BudgetsConfig.description: Agent-authored budget hints. Runtime/operator policy clamps these to effective limits.

OrchestrationConfig.description: Agent-authored high-level orchestration intent. Runtime policy resolves and clamps effective behavior at Task start.

AcceptanceConfig.description: Optional acceptance criteria checked before a Task transitions to completed.

required_files.description: Workspace files that must exist when the Task completes.

path.description: Workspace artifact glob. Paths are workspace-relative by default; an explicit /output/... path is treated as an artifact alias only when requested by acceptance or runtime resource configuration.

type.description: File type used for optional structural validation.

min_size_bytes.description: Minimum file size in bytes; smaller files are rejected.
